import builtins
from collections.abc import Iterator

import pytest

import ralph


def feed_answers(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, answers: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    remaining: Iterator[str] = iter(answers)
    asked: list[str] = []

    def fake_input(question: str) -> str:
        asked.append(question)
        return next(remaining)

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "input", fake_input)
    return asked


def test_build_agent_command_defaults_to_opencode(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", False)
    command = ralph.build_agent_command("do the thing")
    assert command[0] == "opencode"
    assert ralph.OPENCODE_MODEL in command
    assert command[-1] == "do the thing"


def test_build_agent_command_uses_claude_fable_when_enabled(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "claude_mode_enabled", True)
    command = ralph.build_agent_command("do the thing")
    assert command == ["claude", "-p", "do the thing", "--model", ralph.CLAUDE_MODEL]


def test_claude_model_is_fable_5() -> None:
    assert ralph.CLAUDE_MODEL == "claude-fable-5"


def test_ask_use_claude_all_yes(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    asked = feed_answers(monkeypatch, ["y", "yes", "Y"])
    assert ralph.ask_use_claude() is True
    assert len(asked) == 3
    assert "expensive" in asked[2].lower()
    assert "fable 5" in asked[2].lower()


def test_ask_use_claude_declined_immediately(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    asked = feed_answers(monkeypatch, [""])
    assert ralph.ask_use_claude() is False
    assert len(asked) == 1


def test_ask_use_claude_not_signed_in(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    asked = feed_answers(monkeypatch, ["y", "n"])
    assert ralph.ask_use_claude() is False
    assert len(asked) == 2
    assert "signed in" in asked[1].lower()


def test_ask_use_claude_not_sure(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    asked = feed_answers(monkeypatch, ["y", "y", "n"])
    assert ralph.ask_use_claude() is False
    assert len(asked) == 3
